sunflower terminal (osaka) Terminal1

Address : ATC ITM Building 2F 2-D-6, 2-1-10 Nanko Kita, Suminoe-ku, Osaka City, Osaka
559-0034 Japan
Office Phone No. : 06-6613-1571

By train or bus

From either Suminoe Koen Station on the Yotsubashi Subway line or Cosmos Square Station on the Chuo Subway line, take the Newtram to "Trade Center Station." The terminal is a five-minute walk away.

Osaka Municipal Subway

By car

From Osaka City

Take the "Nanko Kita" exit on the Hanshin Expressway Wangan Line. The terminal is a ten-minute drive away.

From Kansai International Airport

Take the "Nanko Minami" exit on the Hanshin Expressway Wangan Line.The terminal is a 15-minute drive away.

From Airport

From Kansai International Airport

Take the limousine bus bound for Osaka Nanko and get off at "Hyatt Regency Osaka".
Please click here for timetable.
From there you will arrive at the terminal in 10 minutes on foot.

From Itami Domestic Airport

Go to "Namba" by limousine bus. Please click here for timetable.
Transfer to Midosuji subway line and get off at "Honmachi" station. From there transfer to Chuo subway line and take the train to "Cosmosquare" station. Transfer to Newtram line and take the newtram to "Trade Center" station.

Beppu Kanko-ko

Address : 944-2 Shiomi-cho, Beppu City, Oita Prefecture
874-0918
Office Phone No. : 0977-22-1311

By train or bus

  • 15 minutes by bus from JR Beppu Station. Three-minute walk from the "Beppu kokusai kankoukou Ferry Sunflower Mae" bus stop.
  • Approx. 10 minutes by taxi from JR Beppu Station.

By car

Approx. 15 minutes from Oita Expressway Beppu IC.

From Airport

From Oita Airport

Take the express bus bound for Beppu Station (Airport Express Airliner) and get off at "Beppu Kotsu Center". Route
Travel time is approximately 41 minutes and the cost of a ticket is JPY1400.
From there you will arrive at the terminal in 8 minutes on foot.
